result:
I made page changes smoother by adding a few lines of CSS to `static/style.css`. I didn't add any JavaScript, and the app still works the same way.

**What changed:**
- **The page cross-fades instead of going blank.** It uses a browser feature called view transitions: on each click, the old page fades into the new one over about 0.15 seconds. This also covers buttons like "Mark done" and "Save".
- **The top bar stays put.** It's the same on every page, so it no longer fades out and back in.
- **No white flash.** The page background was only set on the body, so the browser could briefly show white between pages. It's now set on the whole page.

**Browser support:** This works in Chrome and Edge (version 126 or newer) and in Safari 18.2 or newer. Browsers without the feature, such as older Firefox versions, just load pages the normal way, so nothing breaks.

**Not tested in a browser:** I haven't seen the fade work myself, because screenshots can't capture animation. To try it, restart the app if it's running, then hard-refresh once (Cmd+Shift+R) so your browser loads the new CSS.

If you want it smoother still, the next step would be loading pages with JavaScript instead of full page reloads. That would make the code noticeably more complex, so I'd only do it if the fade isn't enough.
